title: Decision Intelligence & Research Optimisation
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.4 — Multimodal Crop Intelligence & Hybrid Twin Learning
database_migration: Additive models_evidence/research_evidence.sqlite schema 1.3.0 adds decision_runs, state_assimilations, causal_analyses and recommendation_status_history, plus optional state_assimilations.sequence_json. Field Operations, Maize Pollination Lab and Persistent Twin schemas are unchanged.
key_features: Researcher-facing Decision Intelligence workspace with readiness, provenance and explicit compare-record-measure-evaluate workflow
Mapped-field irrigation policy comparison using existing FAO-style root-zone model and direct NASA POWER or Research Data Hub weather
Optional recorded soil-moisture sensor-threshold policy comparison without hardware control
Pareto-efficient irrigation alternatives with water/stress/loss, optional seasonal water/event constraints and economics
Local empirical N/P/K response surfaces with group-aware validation, bounded scenario search and Pareto trade-offs
Uncertainty-weighted single, time-varying and repeated-measurement state assimilation with same-state/unit safeguards
Universal recommendation status and separate treatment/outcome follow-up records
Observational causal audit with categorical/numeric binary treatments, cross-fitting, IPW, T-learner, AIPW-style estimation, overlap/balance/ESS diagnostics and placebo checks
Additive Research Evidence DB 1.3.0 decision_runs, state_assimilations and causal_analyses tables
Automatic NASA acquisition provenance for irrigation decision runs
Explicit confirmation before a research recommendation can create a Field Operations task
Append-only recommendation status-history audit trail with optional researcher reasons for transitions
Causal audit stores explicit treated level, effect direction and researcher adjustment-rationale / causal-graph notes
paper_method_adaptations: Seq2Seq + deep-RL irrigation literature -> transparent state/policy separation and policy comparison; exact Seq2Seq/DRL not implemented
Spatial multi-objective fertilizer optimisation -> empirical response + Pareto grid; exact NSGA-II not implemented
EO/crop-model N assimilation literature -> generic uncertainty-weighted same-state assimilation foundation; crop-specific observation operator not implemented
Causal digital-agriculture evaluation -> independent cross-fitted observational estimators and diagnostics; no causal-proof claim
not_claimed_as_implemented: Exact Seq2Seq soil-moisture forecasting from the reviewed irrigation paper
Exact deep reinforcement-learning irrigation policy or autonomous irrigation control
Exact crop-specific remote-sensing/crop-model nitrogen assimilation and bisection optimiser
Universal or externally validated N/P/K prescriptions
Exact MMST-ViT, PhenoYieldNet, PB-CNN, ALIC or SCM-GAT implementations
limitations: NASA POWER is gridded historical/near-real-time environmental data, not local station measurement or a future operational forecast.
Irrigation outputs are research scenarios and do not control pumps, valves or external systems.
Ky relative-yield response is a stress proxy unless independently calibrated for the intended crop/site.
Nutrient optimisation requires measured outcomes and actual nutrient-rate variation; validity is bounded by the fitted data and validation scope.
State assimilation requires compatible state definitions/units or a validated observation operator.
Observational causal estimates remain vulnerable to unmeasured confounding, interference, poor positivity, measurement error and misspecification.
Pareto efficiency is not agronomic validation or an operational safety guarantee.
